tasks.objective: Fix the oracle-leakage smoke so schema-defined timestamp metadata cannot cause nondeterministic false positives while real evaluator-answer leakage remains fail-closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Timestamp-like metadata that merely collides with evaluator text must not be reported as oracle leakage.
Actual evaluator-answer leakage through non-metadata fields must still be rejected.
Existing smoke and product behavior must remain deterministic.

tasks.objective: Fix OpenAI-compatible RunPod error classification so proxy and endpoint failures are distinct from genuine model-not-found responses and diagnostics remain bounded.
acceptanceCriteria: Authentication, timeout, rate-limit, network, server, proxy, endpoint, and genuine model-not-found failures must remain distinguishable.
The client must stay fail-closed with one call and zero generic retries.
Diagnostics must not expose credentials.

tasks.objective: Fix the RunPod bootstrap regression checks so stale package-script assumptions and intentional fake redaction sentinels do not create false review failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Bootstrap smoke must no longer depend on the stale package-script assertion.
Intentional fake test values must not be mistaken for real sensitive-boundary violations.
Existing bootstrap safety checks must remain intact.

tasks.objective: Fix Bounded Agent Review false positives by narrowing controlled-pilot scope handling and sensitive assignment detection without weakening real secret detection.
acceptanceCriteria: Controlled-pilot paths required by the task must be reviewable without opening unrelated script scope.
Identifier references to sensitive names must not be treated as literal credential assignments.
Real literal credential assignments must remain error-level findings.

tasks.objective: Fix the Gate 5 external ablation so each context strategy receives genuinely different repository-derived context and the task-relevant hidden oracle remains evaluator-only.
acceptanceCriteria: All context modes must use the immutable repository snapshot rather than effectively identical placeholder payloads.
Provider-visible context must differ according to the selected strategy.
Hidden oracle data must remain outside provider-visible input.

tasks.objective: Add repository-local bounded onboarding with init and doctor commands that detect the JavaScript/TypeScript project configuration and create fail-closed local config and policy files.
acceptanceCriteria: Initialization must detect the Git root and package-manager/project scripts deterministically.
Initialization must refuse silent overwrite and roll back partial creation failures.
Doctor must detect config drift and invalid prerequisites without mutating source files.

tasks.objective: Expand bounded doctor into deterministic environment, repository, Codex configuration, and validation diagnostics without making a model call.
acceptanceCriteria: Doctor must report environment, repository, Codex, and validation checks deterministically.
Missing authentication or validation prerequisites must be surfaced fail-closed.
Doctor must never invoke agent/model execution.

tasks.objective: Add prompt-driven bounded Codex execution with an explicit mutable file scope, disposable coding workspace, deterministic verification, and no automatic apply.
acceptanceCriteria: Only explicitly allowed files may be mutable while bounded read-only support context may be added deterministically.
The source repository must remain unchanged during candidate generation and verification.
The command must report actual agent/model/context/token/validation observations without fabricating unavailable telemetry.

tasks.objective: Add read-only Codex scope discovery for prompt-only bounded coding, with public repository grounding and explicit developer approval before mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: Discovery must run read-only with network disabled and must not receive hidden solution/oracle data.
Suggested files and symbols must be grounded in canonical public repository facts.
Non-interactive execution must stop at approval-required without starting mutation.

tasks.objective: Add a separate human-approved bounded apply step that rechecks source currentness and delegates real repository mutation to the existing governed apply path.
acceptanceCriteria: Validated candidates must not be applied automatically.
The candidate diff must be shown before explicit approval and the default answer must be no.
Source drift before apply must fail closed into recovery-required without uncontrolled repository writes.

tasks.objective: Add an offline integration regression for the complete controlled-coding pilot evidence bundler, verifier, and acceptance chain.
acceptanceCriteria: The regression must cover the successful production evidence chain end to end.
Tampered, missing, extra, symlinked, wrong-source, and failed-governance evidence must be rejected.
Repeated valid runs must produce deterministic artifacts and hashes.

tasks.objective: Add a deterministic offline regression contract for the Gate 5 live external A/B/C/D/E runner while preserving evaluator-only hidden oracle separation.
acceptanceCriteria: Fixture mode must exercise all five comparable modes without live provider calls.
Provider-visible payloads must not contain hidden oracle answers.
The report must retain repository/model/provider identity and a deterministic integrity hash.

tasks.objective: Add a regression runner that materializes the immutable external repository snapshot, verifies its fixed commit and boundaries, runs read-only acceptance, and proves checkout cleanliness.
acceptanceCriteria: The external checkout must be pinned to the exact immutable commit.
Allowed and forbidden boundary files must be verified before acceptance.
Read-only validation must leave the external checkout unchanged.

tasks.objective: Add the first deterministic hidden-oracle harness proving evaluator answers stay outside provider-visible input while selections are scored after provider output.
acceptanceCriteria: Provider-visible requests must contain no serialized hidden expected answers.
The evaluator must score seed, symbol, test, and planned-file selection only after provider output.
The offline regression must remain deterministic and make no live model claim.

tasks.objective: Add focused fail-closed regression coverage for the Gate 6 task schema, including immutable commit, task-class, difficulty, path, duplicate, and authority validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid tasks must parse deterministically without input mutation.
Invalid or floating commit identities, unknown schema/class/difficulty, traversal, duplicate paths, and authority violations must be rejected.
Taskset-level duplicate task IDs must fail closed.

tasks.objective: Add a local product run artifact format and filesystem store with private permissions, atomic installation, integrity metadata, and secret-safe serialization.
acceptanceCriteria: A run must persist the canonical run metadata and sibling candidate, receipt, telemetry, and validation artifacts atomically.
Traversal, symlink, overwrite, and raw-secret persistence must fail closed.
Artifact hashes and byte lengths must describe the bytes actually persisted.

tasks.objective: Add bounded history and report commands over stored product runs, including integrity verification and human/JSON rendering.
acceptanceCriteria: History must enumerate stored product runs without fabricating unavailable historical metadata.
Report must verify stored artifact hashes and reject tampering or unsafe run entries.
Human and JSON output must expose the documented run summary fields consistently.

tasks.objective: Add an independent Product V1 Normal-versus-Bounded comparison identity contract without changing the historical research comparative evidence schema.
acceptanceCriteria: Comparison arms must match task, source snapshot/commit, agent/model/reasoning, validation, network, and timeout identity to be comparable.
Any identity mismatch must deterministically mark the sample non-comparable.
The research comparative evidence contract must remain unchanged.

tasks.objective: Add a twin-workspace Product V1 comparison runner that executes Normal and Bounded agents independently on one frozen source snapshot with the same execution identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Normal and Bounded arms must use distinct disposable workspaces created before either arm runs.
The Normal arm receives full eligible context while Bounded receives only selected context and approved mutable scope.
Source repository mutation and bounded out-of-scope mutation must fail closed.

tasks.objective: Add the Product Comparison V1 evaluator for correctness, control, and efficiency metrics while preserving missing telemetry as unavailable and keeping hidden expected patches out of the evaluator input.
acceptanceCriteria: Correctness, control, and efficiency metrics must be derived from observed comparison evidence.
Missing telemetry or incomplete changed-file necessity labels must remain null rather than being fabricated.
Hidden expected patches and direct caller-supplied unnecessary-file counts must be rejected.
